product_one_liner.value: Curve Dental provides cloud-based dental practice-management software for dental practices, bringing clinical care, scheduling, insurance, billing, payments and patient engagement together in one platform.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes an AI-powered, cloud-based dental practice-management platform connecting clinical care, scheduling, insurance, billing, payments and patient engagement.

pricing_page.notes: Curve has a public pricing page, which describes its pricing and invites visitors to request personalized pricing information.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The cited customer materials identify Dental Choice and Emerson Dental as Curve Dental customers. | named_customers.0: The case study identifies Dental Choice as a practice using Curve’s platform. | named_customers.1: The customer case study identifies Emerson Dental as a user of Curve’s solution.

employee_band.notes: The company’s LinkedIn profile lists 215 employees, which falls within the 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The corporate headquarters address on the contact page is in Alpharetta, Georgia. | hq_country: The contact page identifies the corporate headquarters and gives its address in Alpharetta, Georgia, USA.

founded_year.notes: Curve Dental’s About page states it was founded in 2004.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows product, AI-use and practice-management content, not at least two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built. Under the specified criteria, this is not an engineering or technical blog.

public_docs.notes: Curve has a public help center with multiple product articles and linked instructional pages, satisfying the public documentation criterion.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers listing includes an AI/ML Platform Software Developer position, matching the specified AI/ML role criteria.

model_provider.value: Pearl AI (its Second Opinion AI integration for dental radiographs)
model_provider.notes: The integration material names Pearl AI and describes accessing Pearl’s software from Curve to obtain AI second opinions on dental radiographs.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The data-policy page names SOC 2 and ISO 27001, specifying that the data center maintains SOC 2 compliance and is ISO 27001 certified. These are the named certifications; the page’s separate HIPAA language is not a certification claim. | compliance_certs.0: The data-policy page explicitly names SOC 2 compliance for the data center. | compliance_certs.1: The data-policy page explicitly says the data center is ISO 27001 certified.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding profile identifies the latest and only disclosed round as Series A. | funding_date: The funding profile identifies its one Series A round as dated February 8, 2018, reported here as 2018-02. | funding_amount_usd: The funding profile and 2018 investment announcement describe the amount as undisclosed, so no numeric USD amount can be reported.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile reports one Series A round in February 2018, outside the 18-month window. The 2026 announcement describes investment in the Curve Hero product, not a new funding round.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers listing includes a Sales/Business Development Representative role, which matches the hiring criterion.

launched_6mo.notes: Curve announced Curve Memberships on September 3, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A dated September 29, 2026 announcement says Curve appointed Rick Hansen as Chief Customer Officer, within the 12-month window ending November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A Curve Dental job listing explicitly names Salesforce and Gong as systems used to update prospect data and track sales opportunities and activities. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job listing names Salesforce as a sales system Curve uses. | crm_stack_signal.1: The same job listing names Gong as a sales system Curve uses.
